symptom: mendixlabs/mxcli#1139 (ako/mxcli#1282): asked for Studio Pro's 'Disable activity' in MDL; it is `@excluded` on a statement, kept since #1328. Residual: `@excluded if $b then … end if;` (or on a loop, while, return, raise error) passed check and exec and was dropped — describe showed no @excluded and the branch ran — and `mxcli syntax microflow layout` said @excluded is a DOCUMENT annotation that does not go on a statement
cause: only ActionActivity has Disabled (Model SDK: ActionActivity.disabled, introduced 9.12.0, on no other type), so applyAnnotations has nowhere to put it on an ExclusiveSplit/LoopedActivity/event and silently skips it; no check reported the drop. The syntax help predated activity-level @excluded
file: mdl/executor/validate_microflow.go (checkExcludedOnNonActivity, called from checkUnknownAnnotations so it covers microflows, nanoflows and handler bodies), cmd/mxcli/syntax/features_microflow.go, .claude/skills/mendix/write-microflows/SKILL.md
fix: MDL095 warning for @excluded on a decision, loop, end/error/break/continue event or merge, naming the activities as the place to put it; help and skill document statement-level @excluded as 'Disable activity'
test: mdl/executor/issue1139_excluded_non_activity_test.go (decision, loop, while, return, raise error, nested, nanoflow; activity forms stay quiet). Control: with the rule constant but no check every case failed 'want one MDL095, got []'. Real run on 11.12.4: describe of the decision microflow printed no @excluded, the activity and nanoflow-call forms printed it back
insight: Re-run the reporter's exact repro on main before fixing: the headline symptom of #1282 was already fixed by #1328, and the triage comment named the remaining part precisely. What was left were the shapes the fix did not cover (non-activity statements) and documentation that contradicted the feature — the help text telling users @excluded does not go on a statement is probably why the request stayed open. A warning, not a refusal, matches MDL042 (caption on a loop), the same drop shape
